about.en: Adobe bStock (ADBEB) is a tokenized share of Adobe Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x65c0249d49e3231540fd0db0a1ae9259e6eaaf57, backed 1:1 by ADBE shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
